template:
[project]
name = "{{package}}"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.12,<3.13"
dependencies = [
    "PyJWT[crypto]==2.15.1",
    "Authlib==1.8.0",
    "firebase-admin==7.7.0",
    "google-cloud-storage==3.15.1",
    "boto3==1.43.105",
    "beanie==2.2.0",
    "pymongo==4.18.2",
    "redis==8.1.0",
    "requests==2.32.5",
    "fastapi==0.118.0",
    "uvicorn==0.53.0",
    "sqlalchemy==2.0.44",
    "psycopg[binary]==3.3.6",
    "alembic==1.20.0",
    "pydantic==2.11.9",
]

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "httpx==0.28.1", "ruff==0.16.6", "mypy==2.3.1",
    "pylint==4.0.9", "isort==9.0.2", "boto3-stubs[s3]==1.43.106",
    "types-requests==2.33.0.20260906", "types-authlib==1.8.0.20260911",
]

[tool.uv]
package = false
[tool.ruff]
target-version = "py312"
line-length = 79
indent-width = 4

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "I", "UP", "B", "SIM", "RET", "ARG", "C4", "A", "ANN", "RUF", "PGH"]

[tool.ruff.lint.isort]
known-first-party = ["{{package}}"]
known-third-party = ["alembic"]
combine-as-imports = true

[tool.ruff.format]
quote-style = "double"
indent-style = "space"
line-ending = "lf"
docstring-code-format = true

[tool.mypy]
plugins = ["pydantic.mypy"]
python_version = "3.12"
strict = true
disallow_any_unimported = true
disallow_any_explicit = true
show_error_codes = true
pretty = false

[tool.pydantic-mypy]
init_typed = true
init_forbid_extra = true

[tool.pylint.format]
max-line-length = 79

[tool.pylint.imports]
known-third-party = ["alembic"]

[tool.isort]
profile = "black"
line_length = 79
combine_as_imports = true
known_third_party = ["alembic"]
force_sort_within_sections = false

known_first_party = ["{{package}}"]

[tool.som.python-quality]
contract = "som.python-quality.v1"
profile_sha256 = "4cac7c6758372d4608895c53f1f427992d86988c85ff348c4eed7882efa762b4"
contract_sha256 = "b4385d3a160a2b3efc2e7e92260aee07ec83b09cd0d1bcddbd0154123b8cb063"
exceptions_sha256 = "7bc025b96816211e654c16120d6d3fe1c6e53c33841e034b3c43889705af2905"
dependencies_sha256 = "3ba2b1eef8d3463af9390b4bfa8f6df5810e4609c0844a96b1a45dd1448e233f"
formatter_sha256 = "cb0cdeba051c5c5bdc85c22dc31440ac1ea17651366bf188d4df1f8fe985933a"
exception_registry = '''[{"symbol":"models.Base and generated SQLAlchemy mapped classes","rule":"pylint:too-few-public-methods","reason":"Mapped data classes expose fields rather than application methods.","verification":"real PostgreSQL CRUD and migration inspection"},{"symbol":"app.create_router","rule":"pylint:too-many-locals,too-many-statements","reason":"The composition factory registers the requested routes. Each route receives its own checks.","verification":"operation subsets, route ordering and independent HTTP behavior"},{"symbol":"alembic.env.context.configure,begin_transaction,run_migrations,is_offline_mode","rule":"pylint:no-member","reason":"Alembic installs these proxy symbols dynamically.","verification":"migration upgrade, downgrade and upgrade again"},{"symbol":"alembic.versions.op.create_table,create_index,drop_table","rule":"pylint:no-member","reason":"Alembic installs these operation proxy symbols dynamically.","verification":"migration upgrade, database constraints and downgrade"},{"symbol":"alembic.versions.revision,down_revision,branch_labels,depends_on","rule":"pylint:invalid-name","reason":"Alembic requires these exact lowercase module symbols.","verification":"Alembic revision graph and upgrade/downgrade"},{"symbol":"integrations.firebase_admin,integrations._fb_auth,integrations._fb_creds,integrations._fb_errors,integrations.gcs_storage","rule":"mypy:import-untyped","reason":"Pinned Firebase and GCS distributions do not provide py.typed. Imports are isolated to the SDK boundary. Identity claims and downloaded bytes receive first-party validation.","verification":"malformed claims, expired and revoked tokens, byte integrity, provider failure and recovery"},{"symbol":"integrations.LocalFirebaseCredential base _fb_creds.Base","rule":"mypy:misc,no-any-unimported","reason":"Firebase requires its untyped SDK credential base. The override returns the typed Google Credentials interface.","verification":"Firebase emulator login with revocation and provider failure checks"},{"symbol":"integrations.LocalFirebaseCredential.get_credential and integrations.local_gcs_credentials AnonymousCredentials constructor","rule":"mypy:no-untyped-call","reason":"Google's zero-argument test credential constructor lacks an annotation. Only the constructor call receives this exception.","verification":"loopback-only configuration and mock authentication/object operations"},{"symbol":"models generated Beanie classes id","rule":"mypy:assignment","reason":"Beanie declares ObjectId by default. This contract uses transactional integer counters and aliases the integer to _id.","verification":"integer ID persistence, restart, concurrent transactions and independent MongoDB inspection"},{"symbol":"models generated Beanie classes","rule":"pylint:too-many-ancestors","reason":"The inherited SDK Document implementation has nine ancestors. The generated class adds no new inheritance layers.","verification":"all MongoDB CRUD, transactions and migration cases"},{"symbol":"models generated Beanie Settings classes","rule":"pylint:too-few-public-methods","reason":"Beanie discovers this data-only settings class by name.","verification":"unique, foreign-key and query index inspection"},{"symbol":"models generated Beanie classes field declarations","rule":"pylint:duplicate-code","reason":"The database document and HTTP schema repeat the same contract fields. They have different SDK bases and different managed-field and write-validation rules. The exception applies to data declarations only.","verification":"matching field types, order, defaults, readonly fields and all partial updates"}]'''

[tool.som.python-quality.tools]
ruff = "0.16.6"
mypy = "2.3.1"
pylint = "4.0.9"
isort = "9.0.2"
